```{r setup}
DATOS     <- params$datos
COBERTURA <- params$cobertura
source("R/leer.R")
source("R/tema.R")
source("R/cobertura.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(knitr)
})

votus <- leer_votus() |>
  mutate(tipo = tipo_votu(pick(everything())))
es_eve <- coalesce(votus$tipo == "EVE", FALSE)
votus$nombre <- nombre_virus(votus)
votus$nombre[es_eve] <- nombre_eve(votus[es_eve, ])
cob <- leer_cobertura() |>
  inner_join(select(votus, votu, nombre, tipo, es_virus, clase_final), by = "votu") |>
  filter(!is.na(tipo))
N_MUESTRAS <- n_distinct(leer_lecturas()$muestra)
UMBRAL <- 70
HAY_PERFILES <- hay_perfiles()
```

Data: **`r DATOS`**`r if (HAY_PERFILES) paste0(" and **", COBERTURA, "**") else ""` · viral vOTUs and EVEs only.
Breadth is the percentage of a vOTU covered by at least one read; depth is the mean number of reads covering each position.

# C1. Breadth versus depth

```{r g-breadth-depth, fig.height = 4.6}
pts <- cob |>
  filter(pct_cubierto > 0) |>
  mutate(tipo = factor(tipo, levels = TIPOS))
# el recuento va en el titulo de cada panel para no tapar puntos
resumen <- pts |>
  group_by(tipo) |>
  summarise(n = n(), presentes = sum(pct_cubierto >= UMBRAL), .groups = "drop")
titulos <- setNames(paste0(resumen$tipo, "\n", resumen$presentes, " of ", resumen$n, " ≥ ", UMBRAL, "%"),
                    resumen$tipo)

pc1 <- ggplot(pts, aes(profundidad, pct_cubierto, colour = tipo)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = UMBRAL, linetype = "dashed", colour = TINTA_2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(size = 1.3, alpha = 0.55, stroke = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~ tipo, nrow = 1, labeller = as_labeller(titulos)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01, drop0trailing = TRUE, big.mark = ","),
                expand = expansion(c(0.02, 0.05))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL_TIPO, guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Genome breadth versus mean depth",
       subtitle = paste0("One point per vOTU and pool with any coverage. Dashed line: presence threshold (", UMBRAL, "%)"),
       x = "mean depth (×, log scale)", y = "breadth (% of the vOTU covered)") +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(6, "mm"))
guardar_cob(pc1, "C1_breadth_vs_depth", alto = 95, ancho = 200)
pc1
```

# C2. Depth of each virus in its positive pools

```{r g-depth-per-virus, fig.height = 6.5}
pos <- cob |>
  filter(es_virus == "si", pct_cubierto >= UMBRAL) |>
  group_by(nombre, muestra) |>
  summarise(profundidad = max(profundidad), amplitud = max(pct_cubierto), .groups = "drop")
orden_v <- pos |>
  group_by(nombre) |>
  summarise(med = median(profundidad), amp = median(amplitud), pools = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(med)
pos <- pos |> mutate(nombre = factor(nombre, levels = orden_v$nombre))
etiq <- orden_v |> mutate(nombre = factor(nombre, levels = orden_v$nombre),
                          texto = paste0(pools, "/", N_MUESTRAS, " · ", round(amp), "%"))

pc2 <- ggplot(pos, aes(profundidad, nombre)) +
  geom_point(colour = PAL[["azul"]], size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0) +
  geom_point(data = orden_v |> mutate(nombre = factor(nombre, levels = orden_v$nombre)),
             aes(x = med, y = nombre), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 124, size = 4.5, colour = TINTA) +
  geom_text(data = etiq, aes(x = Inf, y = nombre, label = texto), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = -0.1, size = 2.6, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1, drop0trailing = TRUE, big.mark = ",")) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Mean depth of each virus in the pools where it is present",
       subtitle = "One point per positive pool; vertical tick: median. Right: positive pools · median breadth",
       x = "mean depth (×, log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5))
guardar_cob(pc2, "C2_depth_per_virus", alto = 150, ancho = 200)
pc2
```

# C3. Genome completeness (CheckV)

```{r g-completeness, fig.height = 9}
NIV_CV <- c("Complete", "High-quality", "Medium-quality", "Low-quality", "Not-determined")
comp <- votus |>
  filter(es_virus == "si") |>
  mutate(completeness = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(completeness)),
         calidad = factor(coalesce(na_if(checkv_quality, ""), "Not-determined"), levels = NIV_CV),
         etiqueta = paste0(nombre, " · ", format(round(longitud / 1000, 1), nsmall = 1), " kb")) |>
  arrange(coalesce(completeness, -1), longitud) |>
  # una fila por vOTU: dos vOTUs pueden compartir nombre y longitud redondeada
  mutate(fila = factor(votu, levels = votu))

pc3 <- ggplot(comp, aes(coalesce(completeness, 0), fila, fill = calidad)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(data = filter(comp, is.na(completeness)), aes(x = 1, label = "not determined"),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = setNames(comp$etiqueta, comp$votu)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c(rev(AZUL_ORD), GRIS), NIV_CV),
                    breaks = intersect(NIV_CV[-5], as.character(comp$calidad))) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                     expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Estimated completeness of the viral vOTUs",
       subtitle = "CheckV completeness of each vOTU (one row per vOTU, with its length)",
       x = "completeness", y = NULL,
       caption = str_wrap("CheckV cannot estimate completeness for many RNA viruses that lack close references; those rows are marked 'not determined'.", 120)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
guardar_cob(pc3, "C3_completeness", alto = 220, ancho = 200)
pc3
```

# C4. Coverage along the genome

```{r perfiles, eval = HAY_PERFILES}
perf <- leer_perfiles() |>
  inner_join(select(votus, votu, nombre, tipo, longitud), by = "votu")
presentes <- cob |> filter(pct_cubierto >= UMBRAL) |> distinct(votu, muestra)
# una vOTU por nombre: la que esta presente en mas pools y, a igualdad, la de
# mayor profundidad mediana (la mas larga no siempre es la representativa: la de
# 15.5 kb de Aedes anphevirus recoge menos lecturas que las de 13 kb)
repr <- cob |>
  filter(pct_cubierto >= UMBRAL, votu %in% perf$votu) |>
  group_by(nombre, votu) |>
  summarise(pools = n(), prof = median(profundidad), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(nombre) |>
  arrange(desc(pools), desc(prof), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 1) |>
  ungroup()
perf_p <- perf |>
  semi_join(presentes, by = c("votu", "muestra")) |>
  filter(votu %in% repr$votu) |>
  mutate(pos_kb = (inicio + fin) / 2000)
n_pools <- perf_p |> distinct(nombre, muestra) |> count(nombre, name = "pools")
```

```{r g-profiles-virus, eval = HAY_PERFILES, fig.height = 9, results = "asis"}
pv <- perf_p |>
  filter(tipo != "EVE") |>
  semi_join(filter(n_pools, pools >= 2), by = "nombre") |>
  left_join(n_pools, by = "nombre") |>
  mutate(panel = paste0(nombre, "  (", pools, " pools)"))

if (nrow(pv) == 0) {
  cat("No virus with a coverage profile in at least 2 pools.")
} else {
pc4 <- ggplot(pv, aes(pos_kb, profundidad + 0.1, group = muestra, colour = tipo)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3, labeller = label_wrap_gen(38)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL_TIPO, drop = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Depth along the genome, one line per positive pool",
       subtitle = "Viruses present in at least 2 pools; for each, the vOTU present in most pools; mean depth in windows of 50 bp",
       x = "position (kb)", y = "depth (×, log scale)") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 7))
guardar_cob(pc4, "C4_profiles_viruses", alto = 230, ancho = 200)
print(pc4)
}
```

```{r g-profiles-eve, eval = HAY_PERFILES, fig.height = 5.5, results = "asis"}
pe <- perf_p |>
  filter(tipo == "EVE") |>
  left_join(n_pools, by = "nombre") |>
  mutate(panel = paste0(nombre, "  (", pools, " pools)"))
top_eve <- pe |> distinct(panel, pools) |> slice_max(pools, n = 9, with_ties = FALSE) |> pull(panel)

if (length(top_eve) == 0) {
  cat("No EVE vOTU reaches the presence threshold in any pool.")
} else {
pc5 <- ggplot(filter(pe, panel %in% top_eve), aes(pos_kb, profundidad + 0.1, group = muestra)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.6, colour = COL_TIPO[["EVE"]]) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", ncol = 3, labeller = label_wrap_gen(38)) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = label_number(accuracy = 1, big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(title = "For comparison: depth along EVE vOTUs",
       subtitle = "The EVEs present in most pools, named after their viral hit",
       x = "position (kb)", y = "depth (×, log scale)") +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 7.5), axis.text = element_text(size = 7))
guardar_cob(pc5, "C5_profiles_eves", alto = 150, ancho = 200)
print(pc5)
}
```

```{r table-uniformity, eval = HAY_PERFILES}
uniformidad(perf_p) |>
  left_join(distinct(perf_p, votu, nombre, tipo), by = "votu") |>
  group_by(Type = tipo, Name = nombre) |>
  summarise(Pools = n(),
            `Median depth (×)` = round(median(prof_media), 1),
            `Median CV` = round(median(cv, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
            `Windows ≥ 1× (median)` = paste0(round(100 * median(frac_ventanas_1x)), "%"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(Type, desc(Pools)) |>
  kable(caption = "Evenness of coverage in the positive pools. A genome covered end to end has most windows at ≥ 1× and a moderate CV; patchy coverage (high CV, many empty windows) is what partial EVE transcripts or cross-mapped fragments look like.")
```
